description: Post-Session-2 questionnaire: System Usability Scale (SUS) plus custom trust and usefulness items for NutriCoachAI pilot study.
administration: Paper, Google Form, or local web form immediately after Session 2 tasks (before interview).

scoring_notes.sus: For items 1,3,5,7,9: score = response - 1. For items 2,4,6,8,10: score = 5 - response. SUS = sum × 2.5 (range 0–100).
scoring_notes.custom: Likert 1–5; higher = more agreement unless noted.

sections.title: System Usability Scale (SUS)
sections.reference: Brooke, J. (1996). SUS: A quick and dirty usability scale.

items.text: I think that I would like to use this system frequently.
I found the system unnecessarily complex.
I thought the system was easy to use.
I think that I would need the support of a technical person to be able to use this system.
I found the various functions in this system were well integrated.
I thought there was too much inconsistency in this system.
I would imagine that most people would learn to use this system very quickly.
I found the system very cumbersome to use.
I felt very confident using the system.
I needed to learn a lot of things before I could get going with this system.
I trusted that the coach remembered what I told it in the previous session.
The nutrition advice felt relevant to my personal goal and dietary restrictions.
The food comparison (e.g. pizza vs stir-fry) helped me think through a real takeaway decision.
I felt comfortable that my health data stayed on this computer rather than being sent to a cloud service.
I would use a system like this again for everyday nutrition questions (not as a substitute for a doctor or dietitian).
What was the most helpful part of the coach?
